newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait bourse index almost unchanged, trade rises.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait bourse index almost unchanged, trade rises.

text.p: Kuwait Stock Exchange's (KSE) index ended the week to Wednesday almost unchanged easing 0.7 point to 2,411.3, figures released on Thursday show.
But, trade value and volume rose considerably compared to the previous week.

Daily average of traded shares' value clocked up 79 percent to 25.38 million dinars ($83 million) from 14.18 million dinars. Trade volume rose 93.2 percent to a daily average of 86.4 million shares from 44.7 million, KSE figures show.
Losers led gainers 33-18, while 20 shares were non-movers.
Industrials were the most active sector in terms of traded value with 31 million dinars, followed by service firms with 26 million and investment firms with 21.3 million.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
